decisions.reason: The construction site dumper is close to the firm's core construction and industrial transport business, so its learning value and platform fit still justify keeping the option open.

The inclined furniture lift sits further from the firm's main specialized industrial niches, and after several years the remaining uncertainty is likely too low to justify continued attention if traction has not clearly emerged.

The inclined building material lift serves construction customers directly and likely uses the firm's existing lifting, engineering and service capabilities, making continued commercialization worthwhile.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is a more resource-intensive variant in a comparatively peripheral segment, so real-options logic favors redeploying resources once its market potential appears only moderate.
